summary: The requested product needs a small deterministic implementation plan with visible success criteria.
requirements: The product must execute the requested outcome through the canonical workflow.
The result must expose deterministic validation evidence and a final hash proof.

dependencies.description: Deterministic proof depends on the requested product behavior requirement.

plan_steps.description: Validate the completed product and produce deterministic proof.

success_meaning: The requested product behavior is represented by the plan and reaches deterministic canonical proof.

success_criteria.statement: Requested product behavior is represented in the plan.
success_criteria.measurement: At least one plan step references the product requirement.

success_criteria.statement: Deterministic proof is represented in the plan.
success_criteria.measurement: At least one plan step references the proof requirement.
